description: Saves a document to a new file, which it then is (not a copy). Refuses an existing file unless overwrite. A drawing's file only is written: its views keep their models' paths. References issued before keep working. Checked on disk: the file was written by this call.

document.description: The document: its title, its full path, or its file name with the extension (e.g. part.SLDPRT, part.SLDDRW), which picks exactly that document. A name several open documents share is refused with the candidates. The active document when absent.

path.description: Full path of the new file, in an existing folder, with the document's own extension (.SLDPRT for a part).

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it exists. Default false.
